added.summary: font-family's optional generic families follow CSS Fonts 4 §2.1.3: system-ui and ui-sans-serif take the style's body face, ui-monospace and ui-rounded its own mono and rounded faces, and where the style has no face that suits one (always for ui-serif and math) the family list goes on to its next family.

breaking.change: ui-monospace and ui-rounded no longer stand in for a style without a mono or rounded face of its own (ui-rounded used to take the display face), and ui-serif and math no longer take the body face ahead of later families: each matches nothing there and the next family in the list draws. FontFamily gains a Ui variant.
breaking.fix: End a family list with the generic that should stand in (monospace, sans-serif, fantasy), as in a browser.
